build_shadow_unet: build a ShadowUNet model to predict shadow maps from ambient occlusion input tensors
build_floor_shadow_decoder: build a FloorShadowDecoder model to predict shadow maps from ambient occlusion maps using a U-Net architecture
build_shadow_unet_pose_cond: build a ShadowUNet_PoseCond model to predict shadow maps conditioned on both AO maps and pose vectors
build_pose_to_shadow: build a PoseToShadow model to predict shadow maps directly from pose vectors using FC and conv layers
build_dist_map_shadow_unet: build a DistMapShadowUNet model to predict shadow maps from distance map tensors with multiple joint channels
